# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the canonical repository instructions.

Before working on this repository, read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/STATUS.md`
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`
- relevant ADRs under `docs/adr/`

Follow `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` when applicable.

Do not modify infrastructure or documentation without following the
development and decision-recording rules defined in `AGENTS.md`.
